name: nvh-markdown
description: Novus nvh-markdown: .nvmd highlighting (Markdown, frontmatter, <?nv ?> header, {expr}, template blocks, components, containers), snippets, a project template and commands for the .nvmd to .nvh generator.
author: Lumen

settings.label: novusc path
settings.hint: The Novus compiler that runs the generator.

settings.label: Generator (nvmd.nv)
settings.hint: Empty: nvh-markdown/nvmd.nv in or next to the project, the target of its replace line, or the copy fetched by novusc deps (~/.novus/deps).

settings.label: Content folders
settings.hint: Comma-separated folders or files that Generate all, Clean, Watch and Check work on, relative to the project.

settings.label: Main file for Check
settings.hint: The program that Check hands to novusc check after generating.

settings.label: Regenerate everything
settings.hint: Passes --force: write every .nvh, not only what changed.

settings.label: Generate on save
settings.hint: Writes the .nvh next to a .nvmd file each time it is saved.

settings.label: Check while typing
settings.hint: Translates the text of the open .nvmd file after each pause and shows generator errors as problems. Starts novusc each time.

commands.title: nvmd: Generate all .nvmd in the project
nvmd: Show the generated .nvh of this file
nvmd: Generate and check the program
nvmd: Watch and regenerate in a terminal
